notes_list.title: 📜 Arthashastra
notes_list.basic_overview:
✍️ Author: Kautilya (Chanakya)
📌 Vishay: Rajneeti, arthvyavastha, shasan
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: Arth = paisa/rajneeti → Chanakya ne har cheez ka 'Arth' samjhaya.

notes_list.title: 📜 Rajatarangini
notes_list.basic_overview:
✍️ Author: Kalhana
📌 Kashmir ke rajaon ka itihas
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: Raja + Tarang (lehar) → Kashmir ki lehron jaisa rajaon ka itihas → Kalhana.

notes_list.title: 📜 Ashtadhyayi
notes_list.basic_overview:
✍️ Author: Panini
📌 Sanskrit vyakaran ka granth
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: Ashta = 8 adhyay → 8 adhyay ka vyakaran = Panini.

notes_list.title: 📜 Meghaduta
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: Megh = badal, Doot = sandeshvahak → badal ko doot banane wala = Kalidasa.

notes_list.title: 📜 Mudrarakshasa
notes_list.basic_overview:
✍️ Author: Vishakhadatta
📌 Sanskrit natak (Chanakya vs Rakshasa)
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: Mudra (angoothi) + Rakshasa (mantri) → natak ka lekhak Vishakhadatta.

notes_list.title: 📜 Buddhacharita
notes_list.basic_overview:
✍️ Author: Ashvaghosha
📌 Buddha ki jeevani (Sanskrit mahakavya)
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: Ashva (ghoda) + ghosha → Siddhartha ghode par nikle → Ashvaghosha.

notes_list.title: 📜 Anandamath
notes_list.basic_overview:
✍️ Author: Bankim Chandra Chatterjee
📌 Vande Mataram isi upanyas se
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: Anand + Math → sanyasi vidroh → Vande Mataram → Bankim.

notes_list.title: 📜 Gitanjali
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: Geet + Anjali → geeton ki anjali = Tagore.

notes_list.title: 🪔 Madhushala
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: Madhu (sharab) + Shala → Bachchan (Amitabh ke pita).

notes_list.title: 🪔 Kamayani
notes_list.basic_overview:
✍️ Author: Jaishankar Prasad
📌 Mahakavya (Manu aur Shraddha)
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: Kamayani ka mahakavya = Prasad ka. Prasad (meetha) → meethi kavita.

notes_list.title: 🏛️ The Discovery of India
notes_list.basic_overview:
✍️ Author: Jawaharlal Nehru
📌 Jail me likhi gayi (Ahmednagar Fort, 1944)
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: Nehru ne jail me baith kar India ko 'discover' kiya.

notes_list.title: ✍️ Wings of Fire
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: Fire = Agni missile → Missile Man Kalam.

notes_list.title: 🏅 Imperfect
notes_list.basic_overview:
✍️ Author: Sanjay Manjrekar
📌 Cricketer ki atmakatha
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: Imperfect batting ki kahani → Manjrekar (batsman).

notes_list.title: 📜 Manimekalai
notes_list.basic_overview:
✍️ Author: Sattanar
📌 Tamil mahakavya; nayika Kovalan aur Madhavi ki beti
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: Mani-mekalai = Kovalan + Madhavi ki beti (Silappadikaram ka agla bhag).

notes_list.title: 🏛️ History of British India
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: Mill = 'mil gaya' British India ka itihas (1817).

notes_list.title: ✍️ Amar Jiban
notes_list.basic_overview:
✍️ Author: Rassundari Devi
📌 Bangla ki pehli poori atmakatha (1876)
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: Sundar ras khane se amar ho jaoge → Rassundari → Amar Jiban.

notes_list.title: 📖 Ruskin Bond ki Books
notes_list.basic_overview:
✍️ Author: Ruskin Bond
📚 The Room on the Roof, The Blue Umbrella, A Handful of Nuts, Right to Mussoorie (notes ke anusar)
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: Ruskin → Rassi. Chhat wale ghar (Room on the Roof) ko rassi se baandho, Mussoorie me khud ko rassi se baandh ke rakho.

notes_list.title: 🏛️ Mein Kampf
notes_list.basic_overview:
✍️ Author: Adolf Hitler
📌 Matlab: My Struggle
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: 'Man Cafe' bolo → Mein Kampf → Hitler.

notes_list.title: 📖 Dollar Bahu
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: Dollar wali bahu → Sudha Murty (Infosys wali).

notes_list.title: 🏅 The Test of My Life
notes_list.basic_overview:
✍️ Author: Yuvraj Singh
📌 Cricketer ki atmakatha
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: Yuvi ne cancer ka 'test' pass kiya → Test of My Life.

notes_list.title: ✍️ The Autobiography of an Unknown Indian
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: Nirad C. ne 'Unknown Indian' par autobiography likhi.

notes_list.title: 🎵 The Godfather of Soul
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: Soul music ka Godfather = Brown.

notes_list.title: 📖 A Suitable Boy
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: Suitable boy = Seth ji ka damaad → Vikram Seth.

notes_list.title: 📖 Chetan Bhagat (ladkiyon wali books)
notes_list.basic_overview:
✍️ Author: Chetan Bhagat
📚 Examples: One Indian Girl, Girl in Room 105, Half Girlfriend
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: Title me Girl / Girlfriend aaye → Chetan Bhagat.

notes_list.title: 📖 The God of Small Things
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: Roy ne chhoti-chhoti cheezon ka God banaya.

notes_list.title: 📖 The Great Gatsby
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: Great Gates B → Gatsby.

notes_list.title: ✍️ Courage and Commitment
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: Great vyakti ke andar courage. Commitment = Margaret (M).

notes_list.title: ✍️ Courage and Conviction
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: Commitment → Margaret, Conviction → General (fauji conviction).

notes_list.title: 🏛️ Living History
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: Hillary = History (H-H) → Living History.

notes_list.title: 📖 The Hidden Hindu
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: Hidden Hindu → Akshat (akshat = pooja ke chawal).

notes_list.title: 📖 Selection Day
notes_list.basic_overview:
✍️ Author: Aravind Adiga
📌 Cricket par upanyas
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: Selection ke liye Adig (Adiga) raho.

notes_list.title: 🏛️ Modi Govt: New Surge of Communalism
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: Sitaram → Ram → communalism ka mudda.

notes_list.title: 📖 Gone Girl
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: G-G → Gone Girl, Gillian.

notes_list.title: ✍️ The Diary of a Young Girl
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: Frank diary → khul ke (frankly) likhi gayi diary.

notes_list.title: 📖 The Great Indian Novel
notes_list.basic_overview:
✍️ Author: Shashi Tharoor
📌 Mahabharata ka vyangya
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: India ka Novel padhoge to Tharoor (thar-thar) kaanpoge.

notes_list.title: ✍️ Khullam Khulla
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: Khullam Khulla pyaar → Rishi Kapoor.

notes_list.title: 🏅 Ace Against Odds
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: Ace = tennis shot → Sania.

notes_list.title: ✍️ An Unsuitable Boy
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: Suitable Boy = Vikram Seth, Unsuitable Boy = Karan Johar.

notes_list.title: 🪔 Stri Purush Tulana
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: Tulna = taraazu → Tarabai.

notes_list.title: 📖 Ignited Minds
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: Ignite = Agni → Agni wale Kalam.

notes_list.title: 📖 Q & A (Slumdog Millionaire)
notes_list.basic_overview:
✍️ Author: Vikas Swarup
📌 Isi par film Slumdog Millionaire bani
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: Vikas Swarup → Vikas karega Millionaire.

notes_list.title: 🎵 Abhinaya Darpana
notes_list.basic_overview:
✍️ Author: Nandikeshvara
📌 Natya / nritya ka granth
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: Darpan (mirror) dekh kar abhinay sudharo → Nandikeshvara.

notes_list.title: 🏛️ Defending India
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: Notes me Jaswant ke saath 'Arrogant' likha hai → Defending India = Jaswant.

notes_list.title: 📖 Malgudi Days
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: Good days aayenge jab Narayan ke Malgudi jaoge.

notes_list.title: 🏅 Playing to Win
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: Saina ne jeetne ke liye khela → Playing to Win.

notes_list.title: 📖 Lajja
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: Nasrin ki nazar me koi lajja nahi rahi → Nazar-Nasrin.

notes_list.title: 🏛️ The Road Ahead
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: Road ke kinare chai peete Bill Gates.

notes_list.title: 🏅 A Shot at History
notes_list.basic_overview:
✍️ Author: Abhinav Bindra
📌 Shooter, Beijing 2008 Olympic gold
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: Shot = shooting → Bindra.

notes_list.title: 📖 Fasting, Feasting
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: Fasting + Feasting dono khane se jude → Desai (Anita Desai).

notes_list.title: 🪔 Mrityunjay
notes_list.basic_overview:
✍️ Author: Shivaji Sawant
📌 Karna par Marathi upanyas
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: Mrityu par vijay → Karna → Shivaji Sawant.

notes_list.title: 🪔 Godan
notes_list.basic_overview:
✍️ Author: Munshi Premchand
📌 Hori ki kahani
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: Godan = gai ka daan → Hori → Premchand.

notes_list.title: ✍️ Atmakatha
notes_list.basic_overview:
✍️ Author: Anna Chandy
📌 Bharat ki pehli mahila High Court judge
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: Anna → Atmakatha (A-A).

notes_list.title: 📖 Boys Don't Cry
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: Pant pehne ladke nahi rote → Meghna Pant.

notes_list.title: 📖 Sultry Days
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: Sultry day Shobha ke.

notes_list.title: 🪔 Ardhakathanak (Half Story)
notes_list.basic_overview:
✍️ Author: Banarasidas Jain
📌 Hindi (Braj) ki pehli atmakatha (1641)
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: Half = Ardha (aadha) → Banarasi Das ki aadhi katha.

notes_list.title: 🎵 My Music, My Life
notes_list.basic_overview:
✍️ Author: Pandit Ravi Shankar
📌 Sitar vadak
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: Ravi mera music.

notes_list.title: ✍️ The Tunnel of Time
notes_list.basic_overview:
✍️ Author: R.K. Laxman
📌 Cartoonist ki atmakatha
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: Laxman ne Time (Times of India) ki tunnel me kaam kiya.

notes_list.title: 🎵 Sangeet Ratnakar
notes_list.basic_overview:
✍️ Author: Sharngadeva
📌 Sangeet shastra ka granth (13vi sadi)
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: Ratnakar = samundar → sangeet ke ratnon ka sagar → Sharngadeva.

notes_list.title: 📖 Narcopolis
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: Narco dept me Police ki Jeet → Jeet Thayil.
